cohort: The study included 118 pregnancies from 94 procedures in highly selected women with recurrent mid-trimester pregnancy loss due to cervical insufficiency who underwent transabdominal cerclage.
finding: In experienced hands, transabdominal cerclage (TAC) during pregnancy is a safe and effective operation for women when less invasive procedures have failed.
followup_time: Up to delivery for each pregnancy (median gestational age at delivery was 37 weeks)
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery was 37 weeks (range 28-39 weeks)
